name: sc-plan-anchor
description: Install plan-anchor (Jev-backed anchors and gates that keep plans and delivered work aligned) into a repository or a parent folder, rendered for br or bd.

interface.longDescription: Installs the plan-anchoring skill and its gate and tuning agents into a repository or a parent folder of repositories, rendered for one anchor tracker (br or bd), and upgrades it by rerunning.
defaultPrompt: Switch plan-anchor to the bd tracker.
